talkcraft_map_route_pin.rule: Common in Johnny Harris, Wendover, LEMMiNO, Half as Interesting. Abstract coastline base map (no real map screenshots: noise and copyright risk); origin pin lights first; one dashed Bezier leg at a time, grow 1.1 s power1.inOut (0.8–1.5 s); pin slams 60 px in 0.25 s power2.in, squash 1.3/0.7, back.out(3) rebound 0.28 s; dust ring 0.2→1.6 over 0.45 s; label slides x −14→0 in 0.2 s; 0.4 s pause between legs.

talkcraft_lower_third.rule: Bar scaleX 0→1 0.3 s power4.out → name clip reveal 0.25 s starting at 70 % of the bar → subtitle +0.15 s; hold 3–5 s; reverse exit ≤0.5 s (subtitle, name, bar last); saturated bar, shadowed text; never under the caption zone; one line ≤ 12 chars.

nominatim.rule: Place coordinates and district/city from OSM Nominatim (ODbL); ≤1 request/s with an identifying UA; attribute OpenStreetMap.

nameplate.when: every shot of a real place
nameplate.position: upper left, above the AI label row, away from subtitles

day_bridge.when: between shots whose day label changes
day_bridge.content: abstract map, route from previous place to next, pin + label, day header

placeRules.rule: Every place must be in the article's itinerary for this package (quote the sentence).
placeRules.source: narration.mjs EVIDENCE check (2026-09-29 Hong Kong night market slip)

placeRules.rule: Verify the district when the first geocoder hit sits on a boundary (시먼딩 → 완화구, not 중정구); use the city when the village name is too fine or renders badly (공항 → 타오위안시).
